scope: Opt-in shared same-host SQLite quotas for authenticated coordinator requests in the mTLS gateway.
shared_quota_scope: Same-host processes sharing one local SQLite file and identical configuration; not cross-host/distributed.
known_limits: Pre-TLS global/per-IP connection bounds remain process-local.
Authenticated quotas begin after HTTP headers parse.
OS boot-ID change resets rate buckets and active leases because monotonic timestamps cannot be compared across boots.
SQLite quota state is trusted local infrastructure; filesystem protection is not cryptographic tamper resistance.
A long-running request whose lease heartbeat remains unavailable beyond TTL can outlive its quota lease; dispatch deadlines and monitoring are required.
No multi-host topology, production CA lifecycle, reverse proxy, OS-level FD cap or upstream CI was tested.
verification_boundary: All evidence is from local reference code and local process/gateway tests. No hosted service or upstream repository was used for a live test.
